name: Alex Agius Saliba - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directive (EU) 2015/2302 to make the protection of travellers more effective and to simplify and clarify certain aspects of the Directive
part_text:
The report sets out Parliament's position on updating EU rules on package holidays. It wants clearer protection for travellers when trips are cancelled, including refunds within 14 days and rules on vouchers. It proposes scrapping the confusing "linked travel arrangement" category and folding more bookings into the "package" definition. It also asks for stronger insolvency protection, better complaint handling, and fines for traders who break the rules.

- **What changes:** Simpler package definition, no linked travel arrangements, refund and voucher rules, complaint handling, fines.
- **Who it affects:** Holidaymakers buying package trips, and travel organisers and retailers selling them.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's position goes to talks with EU governments before any law is final.
